label: mentored
note: Samuel anointed David as Saul's successor while David was still a shepherd boy, at God's direction.

label: collaborated with
note: Aaron served as Moses' spokesman before Pharaoh and co-led Israel through the Exodus, though he also built the golden calf in Moses' absence.

label: collaborated with
note: Jonathan and David formed a covenant friendship; Jonathan repeatedly protected David from Saul at his own risk and forfeited his claim to the throne.

label: clashed with
note: Paul publicly opposed Peter at Antioch, calling him a hypocrite for withdrawing from table fellowship with Gentile believers under pressure from certain Jewish Christians.

label: collaborated with
note: Paul and Peter stood together at the Jerusalem Council affirming that Gentiles are saved by grace apart from the law.

label: clashed with
note: Hagar showed contempt for Sarah once pregnant with Abraham's child, and Sarah in turn dealt harshly with Hagar, then later insisted Abraham cast out both Hagar and Ishmael.

label: guided
note: Naomi guided Ruth into Boaz's field and devised the plan that led to Ruth's marriage to him; Ruth in turn bound herself permanently to Naomi and to Naomi's God rather than return to Moab.

label: secured the throne for
note: When David was old and Adonijah moved to seize the throne, Bathsheba went to David at Nathan's urging and secured his public confirmation that Solomon would reign.
